name: high_ttft
description: Alerts when Time To First Token for LLM streams exceeds 3 seconds repeatedly

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) as total, provider FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('scribe-backend', 'scribe_backend') AND event_type = 'llm_ttft' AND duration_ms > 3000 GROUP BY provider HAVING count(*) > 5
